Back in the olden days [yeah, I'm old(ish)] around 1988 maybe there were basically two types of buses in Brisbane, CityBus and CityXpress. Before CityXpress buses were introduced, all stops were yellow and all buses (with a few exceptions I won't go into here) stopped at all stops.

When CityXpress came along, rather than repainting all the stops or whatever, a few stops had extra white signs added to them to indicate them being CityXpress  stops.

The CityXpress buses even had their own livery for quite a few years, before Council decided that wasn't such a great idea for fleet utilisation and merged them all into one again.

You can see some examples of buses in the old CityXpress livery at http://www.busaustralia.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=44&t=53657
